# Photo Scraper Logic Requirements Quality Checklist: Phase 12 — Photo Scraper CLI & Two-Phase Interactive CSV Ingestion

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of requirements for the standalone Photo Scraper CLI and metadata extraction logic  
**Created**: 2026-10-28  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Directory Traversal & Read-Only Safety Requirements

- [x] CHK001 - Is the read-only filesystem access guarantee specified with explicit prohibition of write, rename, lockfile, and delete actions on scanned archives? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-SCR-001]
- [x] CHK002 - Are noise subfolder filtering requirements explicitly enumerated for all caseless keyword variants (`bad`, `thumb`, `thumbs`, `thumbnails`, `resource.frk`, `misc`)? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-SCR-004]
- [x] CHK003 - Are exclusion rules unambiguously defined for hidden dot folders (`.*`) and system directories? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-SCR-005]
- [x] CHK004 - Does the specification clearly define prefix matching rules for operating system artifact folders like `New Folder` and numbered variations? [Coverage, Spec §REQ-SCR-006]
- [x] CHK005 - Are configured personal noise names (`Tim`, `Maria`) explicitly specified for exclusion from POI candidate generation? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-SCR-007]
- [x] CHK006 - Is the assumption of single-POI representation per leaf directory documented with boundary conditions for nested person subfolders? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-SCR-003, Spec §Assumptions]

## 2. Path Cleaning & Gazetteer Heuristics Requirements

- [x] CHK007 - Are prefix-stripping rules unambiguously specified for alphanumeric sequence patterns (e.g., `1-Tokyo`, `1 - Fussen`, `A-Kobe`, `03 Oaxaca`)? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-SCR-013]
- [x] CHK008 - Are requirements defined for identifying trip folders (`Trip To <Country>`) and validating trailing tokens against an administrative gazetteer? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-SCR-010]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the propagation of ambient country context from ancestor trip folders to nested child folders explicitly specified? [Consistency, Spec §REQ-SCR-011]
- [x] CHK010 - Are country-date suffix patterns (e.g., `Japan 4-03`) specified with exact token isolation and date-stripping rules? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-SCR-012]
- [x] CHK011 - Does the specification define how parenthetical folder content (e.g., `Senso-ji (Asakusa Kannon Temple)`) is partitioned into primary and alternate names? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-SCR-014]
- [x] CHK012 - Are geographic fallback heuristics defined for regional US landmarks lacking coordinates (e.g., defaulting to state `Illinois`)? [Coverage, Spec §REQ-SCR-016]

## 3. Multi-Standard Embedded Metadata & Sidecar Requirements

- [x] CHK013 - Are all supported image file extensions (`.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.tiff`, `.heic`, `.png`, `.webp`, `.dng`) explicitly enumerated in the requirements? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-SCR-017]
- [x] CHK014 - Are embedded metadata extraction requirements specified across EXIF 2.3+, IPTC-IIM, and embedded XMP (RDF/XML) standards? [Coverage, Spec §REQ-SCR-018]
- [x] CHK015 - Are companion sidecar file discovery and parsing rules explicitly defined for Adobe/Darktable `.xmp` and generic `.xml` formats? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-SCR-019]
- [x] CHK016 - Are Google Photos Takeout JSON sidecar requirements defined with specific object paths (`geoData.latitude`, `photoTakenTime.timestamp`)? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-SCR-020]
- [x] CHK017 - Is the coordinate precedence order between embedded image tags and companion sidecars unambiguously specified? [Consistency, Spec §REQ-SCR-021]
- [x] CHK018 - Can coordinate normalization to decimal WGS-84 (`latitude`, `longitude`) be objectively tested and verified? [Measurability, Spec §REQ-SCR-022]
- [x] CHK019 - Is the handling of missing coordinate data across all embedded and sidecar sources explicitly defined as empty fields? [Edge Case, Spec §REQ-SCR-023]
- [x] CHK020 - Does the specification define deterministic resolution when multiple photos in a single folder have differing capture dates? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-SCR-025]
- [x] CHK021 - Are descriptive tag and keyword extraction requirements aligned across EXIF XPKeywords, IPTC Keywords, and XMP dc:subject? [Consistency, Spec §REQ-SCR-026]
- [x] CHK022 - Is the read-only safety invariant explicitly extended to companion sidecar files? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-SCR-027]

## 4. LLM Location Inference & Confidence Scoring Requirements

- [x] CHK023 - Are LLM inference input attributes (path tokens, coordinates, abstracted tags) completely documented? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-SCR-028]
- [x] CHK024 - Is the LLM model configuration strictly constrained with `thinking_budget = 0` and structured Pydantic JSON schema output? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-SCR-029]
- [x] CHK025 - Is the confidence scoring scale quantified as an integer between 0 and 100 with objective criteria for certainty levels? [Measurability, Spec §REQ-SCR-030]
- [x] CHK026 - Are confidence score penalty criteria objectively quantified for generic activities lacking GPS coordinates (e.g., `Sledding` $\le 15$)? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-SCR-031]
- [x] CHK027 - Are ambiguity penalty thresholds explicitly quantified for ubiquitous commercial brands without GPS (e.g., `McDonalds` $\le 30$)? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-SCR-032]
- [x] CHK028 - Is local persistent caching specified with SHA-256 keying over path, coordinate, and tag attributes? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-SCR-033]
- [x] CHK029 - Is the system behavior unambiguously defined when `GOOGLE_API_KEY` or network connectivity is unavailable? [Exception Flow, Spec §REQ-SCR-028 (Unwanted Behaviour), Clarification Q5]

## 5. Incremental Scanning & CSV Export Quality Requirements

- [x] CHK030 - Are incremental scanning requirements specified for `--previous-csv` with exact matching on the `Photo directory` column? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-SCR-008]
- [x] CHK031 - Is the behavior of the optional `--rescan-existing` flag clearly differentiated from default skip mode? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-SCR-009]
- [x] CHK032 - Are all 12 standardized CSV export column headers explicitly specified in exact sequence? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-SCR-034]
- [x] CHK033 - Is the requirement for leaving the `Tags` column empty in the photo scraper export clearly specified? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-SCR-035]
- [x] CHK034 - Are multi-address lists specified with semicolon delimiters maintaining 1:1 index alignment across street, city, state, zip, and country? [Consistency, Spec §REQ-SCR-036]
- [x] CHK035 - Are formula injection neutralization rules (`'`, `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, `\t`, `\r`) explicitly defined for all emitted CSV cells? [Security, Spec §REQ-SCR-038]
- [x] CHK036 - Are fallback requirements specified for leaving cells empty when optional column data is unavailable? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-SCR-037]
